hypotheses.reasoning: At 03:10:47 notification-svc hot-reloaded config revision 796 from config-service, which changed TEMPLATE_SVC_URL to http://template-svc.internal:9090. No release went with it. Up to that point every render worked (the last success was at 03:10:34). From 03:12:01 on, every TemplateClient.render call failed fast with ECONNREFUSED to 10.20.236.197:9090. template-svc itself looks healthy: it keeps logging normal GC lines the whole time, but it gets no more /render requests. So the new URL points somewhere nothing is listening, most likely the wrong port or host. notification-svc then returns 503s, and the gateway shows those as POST /v1/notify failures (#134 and later; these are symptoms). redis, notif-db and notif-worker show nothing abnormal.

Connection refused could also mean the template-svc listener went down. But template-svc keeps logging, it shows no restart or error, and the failures start right after the config change, so this reading is unlikely.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back config-service revision 796, which restores the previous TEMPLATE_SVC_URL for notification-svc. Then check which port and host template-svc actually listens on, and add validation or a health check before config hot-reloads are applied.
